findings.evidence: `grep -rln coxeterRelators TauCeti/` returns only `Presentation/Coxeter.lean` and this new file; `Coxeter.lean:55` states its purpose is "reusable Coxeter-presentation machinery needed by milestone S1", yet it offers no way to build a `CoxeterMatrix` from a diagram, so lines 150-163 and 174-180 are reusable facts hidden in `TauCeti.Sporadic.BabyMonster`.
findings.fix: Add `CoxeterMatrix.ofEdges [DecidableEq B] (edges : List (B × B)) : CoxeterMatrix B` with its `apply` lemma, and a `neighbors`/`mem_neighbors_iff` pair, to `TauCeti/GroupTheory/Presentation/Coxeter.lean`; then this file becomes `def coxeterMatrix : CoxeterMatrix (Fin 11) := .ofEdges edges` and keeps only the group-specific `decide` checks (`edges_eq`, `neighbors_branchNode`, `map_length_neighbors`).
findings.issue: The `coxeterMatrix` construction and all three of its field proofs (`isSymm` via `ext`/`if_congr or_comm`, `diagonal` via `simp`, `off_diagonal` via `split <;> omega`) contain nothing specific to Y433 or to `Fin 11` — they are generic in the edge list and the node type given `DecidableEq`. The same holds for `neighbors` (line 174) and `mem_neighbors_iff` (line 179), which are the generic "read the degree off the matrix" helper. Every future diagram row must re-derive them verbatim; the PR description itself names the in-flight Monster row (#2892) as another Y-diagram presentation.

summary: Proof scripts are short, robust, and free of undocumented defeq manipulation. The one issue is that the generic edge-list-to-CoxeterMatrix construction and its three field proofs, plus the neighbors/degree machinery, are hand-rolled inside a group-specific namespace instead of the reusable Coxeter file.
